slides.title: When the GC asks for your COI and you're not 100% sure it's current:

slides.label: Say this:
slides.title: "Let me pull the current one and send it over today."
slides.body: Calm. Professional. Buys you about four hours.

slides.label: Then do this:
slides.title: Open the policy. Check the dates.
slides.body: Before you hit send. Not after the GC does.

slides.label: If it lapsed:
slides.title: "Renewal's in process. I'll send the new certificate as soon as it's issued."
slides.body: Then call your agent. Today, not Monday.

slides.label: If it's fine:
slides.title: Send it. Then write the expiration date somewhere you'll actually see it.
slides.body: Lots of policies renew around Jan 1. Just saying.

slides.label: Save this
slides.title: For the next 4:55 PM Friday COI request.
slides.body: Send it to the person who handles your insurance.
